name: VendorBench
description: Deepfake image detection is served by three fundamentally different paradigms - commercial APIs, zero-shot vision-language models (LLMs), and open-source detectors - that are rarely evaluated under a common protocol, making direct comparison difficult. We introduce VendorBench-100, a cross-paradigm benchmark that evaluates 36 representative models using a single adversarial 100-image corpus, a unified output schema, and a common evaluation framework.
